en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing three scenes: at upper left a building with several flags stands atop a wooded hill or rocky outcrop, with paths and small figures walking below; at lower left a stag stands by the edge of a lake or river in a forested landscape; on the right a lively terrace beer‑garden or park is depicted, with people seated at tables under trees beside a large building flying a horizontal tricolour flag and flanked by cannons on plinths, with a round tower and timber‑frame buildings in the background. The inscriptions in Gothic script read "Nossen i. Sa." and "Bergschlösschen".
